title: FIVE-VLA: Fast and EffectIVE Autonomous Driving with Recurrent Action Memory
summary: State-of-the-art vision-language-action models (VLA) for autonomous driving face critical limitations: excessive parameter counts, inefficient high-resolution image processing, and lack of temporal memory. We introduce Fast and EffectIVE VLA (FIVE-VLA) to address these through two key contributions. First, we employ an efficient vision encoder that processes high-resolution ($448 \times 896$) images while generating only 98 tokens, over $5\times$ fewer than existing approaches, and bypass text generation entirely for single-pass trajectory prediction. Second, we propose Recurrent Action Memory (RAM), a lightweight module that conditions action prediction on previous action tokens, providing temporal context critical for manoeuvres such as overtaking and emergency braking. With only 641M parameters, FIVE-VLA completes $\sim$10% more routes without traffic rule infractions than the previous state-of-the-art VLA on the challenging Bench2Drive closed-loop driving benchmark. Non-reactive open-loop simulation on the large-scale real-world NVIDIA Physical AI AV dataset shows 10.2% and 7.7% lower collision-violation rates than SimLingo in single- and four-view settings, respectively. Additionally, FIVE-VLA runs at $\sim$30 fps on an A100 and $\sim$4 fps on a T4 GPU (proxy to an edge device), representing an 8-30$\times$ speedup over previous methods.
tldr: FIVE-VLA introduces an efficient vision encoder and Recurrent Action Memory to enable fast, lightweight vision-language-action driving with temporal context, achieving state-of-the-art closed-loop driving performance and real-time inference.
tldr_zh: FIVE-VLA 通过高效的视觉编码器和循环动作记忆，实现了轻量级、具有时间上下文的视觉-语言-动作驾驶模型，在闭环驾驶基准上取得领先性能并支持实时推理。
summary_zh: 最先进的视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）在自动驾驶应用中面临关键限制：参数数量过多、高分辨率图像处理效率低下，以及缺乏时间记忆能力。我们提出了高效视觉-语言-动作模型（FIVE-VLA），通过两项核心贡献解决上述问题。首先，我们采用了一种高效的视觉编码器，能够处理高分辨率（$448 \times 896$）图像，同时仅生成98个令牌，比现有方法减少$5\times$以上，并且在单次轨迹预测中完全跳过了文本生成环节。其次，我们提出了循环动作记忆（RAM）模块，这是一种轻量级组件，通过将动作预测条件建立在先前的动作令牌上，为超车和紧急制动等关键操作提供必要的时间上下文信息。FIVE-VLA模型仅含6.41亿参数，在具有挑战性的Bench2Drive闭环驾驶基准测试中，相比此前最先进的VLA模型，其在不违反交通规则的情况下完成路线的成功率提高了约10%。在大规模真实世界NVIDIA Physical AI AV数据集上进行的非反应式开环仿真中，FIVE-VLA在单视图和四视图设置下的碰撞违规率分别比SimLingo低10.2%和7.7%。此外，FIVE-VLA在A100 GPU上运行速度约为每秒30帧，在T4 GPU（作为边缘设备的代理）上约为每秒4帧，相比以往方法实现了8至30倍的加速。

title: M2Tok: Multi-head Multi-codebook Discrete Action Tokenization for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Recent advancements have successfully adapted autoregressive language models to process multimodal signals, such as images and actions. Since raw action signals are continuous, effective tokenization is essential to map high-dimensional inputs into compact discrete tokens for autoregressive processing. However, existing discrete action tokenizers often suffer from high reconstruction loss, failing to preserve the fine-grained dynamics required for precise control. This "discretization bottleneck" significantly limits the performance ceiling of downstream Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models. To address this, we propose ${M}^2$Tok, a Multi-head Multi-codebook Action Tokenizer designed to minimize reconstruction error and enhance policy performance. Our approach introduces two key structural innovations: (1) we decompose the latent action features into multiple heads, enabling the model to implicitly align specific heads with distinct action dimensions; (2) we assign independent codebooks to each head for quantization. By leveraging the combinatorial nature of multiple codebooks, we significantly expand the representational expressivity of the tokenizer, leading to substantially lower reconstruction loss compared to previous methods. We evaluate the ${M}^2$Tok-based VLA on the RoboTwin, Simpler-Env, and 3 zero-shot real-world tasks. Experimental results demonstrate our method not only achieves superior reconstruction fidelity but also significantly boosts the success rate of VLA models. Comprehensive ablation studies further confirm the effectiveness of the multi-head and multi-codebook mechanisms. Code is available at https://github.com/cpaaax/M2Tok.
tldr: M2Tok is a multi-head multi-codebook action tokenizer for VLA models that reduces reconstruction loss and improves policy success rates by decomposing latent action features into multiple heads with independent codebooks.
tldr_zh: M2Tok 是一种用于 VLA 模型的多头多码本动作分词器，通过将潜在动作特征分解为多个头并分配独立码本，降低了重构损失并提升了策略成功率。
summary_zh: 近期研究进展已成功将自回归语言模型应用于处理多模态信号，如图像和动作。由于原始动作信号是连续性的，有效的分词化对将高维输入映射为紧凑的离散词元以供自回归处理至关重要。然而，现有的离散动作分词器常存在较高的重建损失，无法保留精确控制所需的细粒度动态信息。这一“离散化瓶颈”显著限制了下游视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的性能上限。为解决该问题，我们提出${M}^2$Tok，一种多头部多码本动作分词器，旨在最小化重建误差并提升策略性能。我们的方法引入两项关键结构创新：（1）将潜在动作特征分解为多个头部，使模型能够隐式地将特定头部与不同动作维度对齐；（2）为每个头部分配独立的码本进行量化。通过利用多个码本的组合特性，我们显著扩展了分词器的表示表达能力，与先前方法相比大幅降低了重建损失。我们在RoboTwin、Simpler-Env以及3项零样本真实世界任务上评估了基于${M}^2$Tok的VLA模型。实验结果表明，我们的方法不仅实现了卓越的重建保真度，还显著提升了VLA模型的成功率。全面的消融研究进一步验证了多头部和多码本机制的有效性。代码已开源：https://github.com/cpaaax/M2Tok。

title: ForceDelta-VLA: Distilling Force-Conditioned ActionCorrections for Contact-Rich Manipulation
summary: Force-aware Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies improve contact-rich manipulation, but typically combine task-level motion and contact-dependent adjustment in a single action prediction. Demonstrations provide no explicit labels for decomposing that prediction into a reusable reference action and a correction. We present ForceDelta-VLA, a correction-distillation framework that constructs an explicit force-correction target using paired predictions from a frozen teacher's force-conditioned and learned force-agnostic modes. A separate delay-correction target accounts for reference-action mismatch and the change in reference state. Training uses asynchronous schedule replay with the cached task context available during execution. The resulting lightweight policy adjusts the reference actions using recent force history and robot state, responding to contact changes between reference-action updates without regenerating complete action chunks. Across nine single-arm and bimanual contact-rich tasks, ForceDelta-VLA achieves an 82.2% mean success rate, compared with 54.4% for the original ForceVLA baseline. Direct execution of our Stage-1 Temporal Teacher achieves 70.6%. Relative to ForceVLA, the complete system reduces mean peak contact force over successful trials by approximately 26% on both platforms.
tldr: ForceDelta-VLA introduces a correction-distillation framework that decomposes force-conditioned VLA action prediction into a reusable reference action and a learned force correction, improving contact-rich manipulation success and reducing contact forces across single-arm and bimanual tasks.
tldr_zh: ForceDelta-VLA提出一种修正蒸馏框架，将力条件VLA动作预测分解为可复用参考动作和力修正，提升接触丰富的操作成功率并降低接触力。
summary_zh: 力觉感知的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略能够提升接触丰富的操作任务表现，但通常将任务级运动与接触相关调整合并为单一的动作预测。示范数据未提供显式标签，难以将这一预测分解为可复用的参考动作与修正项。我们提出ForceDelta-VLA，一种修正蒸馏框架，利用冻结教师模型中力条件模式与学习得到的力无关模式的成对预测，构建显式的力修正目标。另设延迟修正目标，用于处理参考动作失配及参考状态变化。训练采用异步调度回放，并在执行阶段缓存任务上下文。所得到的轻量级策略利用近期力历史与机器人状态调整参考动作，在参考动作更新间隔内响应接触变化，无需重新生成完整动作片段。在九项单臂及双臂接触丰富任务中，ForceDelta-VLA实现了82.2%的平均成功率，而原始ForceVLA基线为54.4%。直接执行我们第一阶段的时间教师模型达到70.6%的成功率。相较于ForceVLA，完整系统在两个平台上成功试验的平均峰值接触力均降低约26%。

title: UMI-Bridge: Action-Anchored Latent Alignment across Human and Robot Manipulation Data
summary: Real-robot demonstrations are limited, motivating the use of human manipulation data collected without robots, including egocentric videos and handheld Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) demonstrations. However, differences in viewpoint, embodiment, and available action supervision make it difficult to align representations across these sources according to manipulation motion rather than visual appearance. We introduce UMI-Bridge, which uses UMI as an intermediate domain to align representations according to action equivalence rather than pixel similarity. UMI action supervision anchors the latent representation to end-effector motion and gripper behavior, while synchronized head-wrist observations and paired ego-UMI clips support alignment across views and domains. We train a dual-view latent action model (LAM) on human manipulation data without robot demonstrations, then freeze its wrist teacher and dynamics model to regularize vision-language-action (VLA) post-training on UMI and robot data. The shared wrist interface enables this training-time supervision across both domains while preserving the policy's standard inference architecture. Across three real-robot tasks, UMI-Bridge achieves 91.7% mean success versus 73.3% for Naive Co-training with matched UMI and robot data. On two data-efficiency tasks, it surpasses a full-data Robot-only baseline using 25% of the robot demonstrations together with UMI data. It also achieves 85% and 90% success on two additional tasks learned from UMI demonstrations without task-specific robot demonstrations. These results support action-anchored latent alignment for data-efficient robot learning and UMI-to-robot task transfer.
tldr: UMI-Bridge uses UMI as an intermediate domain to align human and robot manipulation data by action equivalence, enabling data-efficient VLA policy training that achieves high success rates on real-robot tasks without task-specific robot demonstrations.
tldr_zh: UMI-Bridge 利用 UMI 作为中间域，通过动作等价性对齐人类与机器人操作数据，实现数据高效的 VLA 策略训练，在没有任务特定机器人演示的情况下在真实机器人任务上获得高成功率。
summary_zh: 现实机器人演示数据有限，这促使研究者利用无需机器人即可采集的人类操作数据，包括第一人称视角视频和手持式通用操控接口（UMI）演示数据。然而，视角、具身形态以及可用的动作监督信息之间的差异，使得难以依据操作运动而非视觉外观来对齐这些不同来源的数据表征。我们提出UMI-Bridge，该方法以UMI作为中间域，依据动作等价性而非像素相似性来对齐表征。UMI动作监督将潜在表征锚定到末端执行器运动和夹爪行为上，同时同步的头戴-手腕观测以及配对的自我中心视角与UMI片段支持跨视角、跨域对齐。我们在无需机器人演示的人类操作数据上训练了一个双视角潜在动作模型（LAM），随后冻结其手腕教师模型和动力学模型，以在UMI数据和机器人数据上对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型进行后训练正则化。共享的手腕接口使得该训练时监督能够同时应用于两个域，同时保留了策略的标准推理架构。在三个真实机器人任务中，UMI-Bridge的平均成功率达91.7%，而使用匹配的UMI和机器人数据进行朴素协同训练的基线方法仅为73.3%。在两个数据效率任务中，UMI-Bridge利用25%的机器人演示数据并结合UMI数据，超越了使用全部数据的纯机器人基线。此外，在另外两个仅从UMI演示学习、无任务特定机器人演示的任务中，UMI-Bridge分别达到了85%和90%的成功率。这些结果验证了基于动作锚定的潜在对齐方法在数据高效的机器人学习以及从UMI到机器人的任务迁移中的有效性。

title: Reinforcement Learning for Real-Time Vision-Language-Action Policies
summary: Reinforcement learning fine-tuning on top of large, pretrained Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models offers promise for highly reliable robot deployment. However, because of their scale, modern VLA models suffer from high inference latency, so the observation used to select an action is often stale by execution time, creating a distribution shift that can substantially degrade reliability and performance. Prior work has explored asynchronous policy execution to reduce the effect of latency, but these methods are mostly built on imitation learning and offer no mechanism for moving beyond the training distribution toward higher reliability. We close this gap by enabling RL fine-tuning that meets the real-time control requirements of dynamic real-world manipulation. Our approach builds on EXPO-FT, a framework for sample-efficient, reliable VLA fine-tuning with reinforcement learning, and decouples slow, expressive action generation from fast, reactive action edits: a large pretrained VLA proposes action chunks using its strong behavior prior, while a lightweight edit policy performs fast, reactive decision-making by editing actions in response to changes in state, conditioned on the latest observation. We instantiate this as Real-Time EXPO-FT, an RL framework for finetuning real-time VLA policies. On the Kinetix benchmark, Real-Time EXPO-FT enables a delayed policy to achieve the best performance among delayed and non-delayed methods in 10 out of 10 environments. On four dynamic real-world tasks, robot object passing, ball balancing, table soccer kicking, and dynamic object picking, with online robot data capped at 10 minutes, Real-Time EXPO-FT improves average policy performance from 42% to 97%, all without human intervention, demonstrating rapid, sample-efficient adaptation to challenging real-world dynamics. Website: https://pd-perry.github.io/real-time-expo-ft
tldr: This paper introduces Real-Time EXPO-FT, an RL fine-tuning framework for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models that decouples slow action generation from fast reactive action edits, enabling real-time control and achieving significant performance improvements on dynamic manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了Real-Time EXPO-FT，一种用于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的强化学习微调框架，通过将慢速动作生成与快速反应性动作编辑解耦，实现实时控制，并在动态操作任务上取得了显著的性能提升。
summary_zh: 在大型预训练视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型基础上进行强化学习微调，为实现高可靠性的机器人部署提供了前景。然而，由于现代VLA模型规模庞大，其推理延迟较高，导致用于选择动作的观测数据在执行时往往已经过时，从而产生分布偏移，这可能显著降低系统的可靠性与性能。已有研究探索了异步策略执行以减轻延迟的影响，但这些方法大多基于模仿学习，缺乏超越训练分布以提升可靠性的机制。我们通过实现满足动态真实世界操作实时控制要求的强化学习微调来弥合这一差距。我们的方法基于EXPO-FT（一种利用强化学习实现样本高效、可靠VLA微调的框架），将缓慢而富有表现力的动作生成与快速、反应式的动作编辑解耦：大型预训练VLA凭借其强大的行为先验提出动作块，而轻量级编辑策略则根据最新观测，对状态变化做出快速反应式决策，通过编辑动作实现实时控制。我们将此实例化为Real-Time EXPO-FT，一个用于微调实时VLA策略的强化学习框架。在Kinetix基准测试中，Real-Time EXPO-FT使延迟策略在10个环境中的全部10个环境中均取得了优于延迟和非延迟方法的最佳性能。在四项动态真实世界任务中——机器人物体传递、球平衡、桌上足球踢球和动态物体抓取——在在线机器人数据上限为10分钟的条件下，Real-Time EXPO-FT将平均策略性能从42%提升至97%，且全程无需人工干预，展现了面对挑战性真实世界动态的快速、样本高效的适应能力。网站：https://pd-perry.github.io/real-time-expo-ft

title: WholeBodyWAM: Learning Whole-Body World Action Models with Scalable Motion Priors
summary: Humanoid whole-body manipulation requires coordinated whole-body dynamics, yet large-scale trajectories from a target robot are expensive to collect and difficult to scale. In contrast, whole-body motion from human and humanoid sources is abundantly available, although such data cannot be directly used as embodiment-specific robot actions. This work asks whether these scalable motion resources can instead provide a transferable predictive prior for humanoid world-action modeling. We introduce WholeBodyWAM, a humanoid world-action model that learns whole-body dynamics from large-scale heterogeneous motion before target-robot training. We curate UniMotion-4K, a motion corpus spanning more than 4K hours from human videos, native 3D motion datasets, and heterogeneous humanoid platforms, and canonicalize these diverse sources into a unified motion space. A language-conditioned Motion Expert is then pretrained to predict future whole-body motion without target-robot action supervision. During robot post-training, the pretrained Motion Expert is integrated with Video and Action Experts through asymmetric Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) attention, enabling predictive scene dynamics and whole-body motion to jointly inform embodiment-specific action generation. Experiments show that WholeBodyWAM consistently benefits from increased motion-pretraining scale, improves future-motion prediction and downstream task performance, and transfers effectively to real-world humanoid manipulation. Moreover, the pretrained motion prior substantially improves data efficiency under limited target-robot demonstrations.
tldr: WholeBodyWAM learns whole-body robot dynamics from large-scale heterogeneous human and humanoid motion before target-robot training, using a language-conditioned Motion Expert and asymmetric Mixture-of-Transformers, improving real-world humanoid manipulation and data efficiency.
tldr_zh: WholeBodyWAM 通过从大规模异构人体和仿人运动数据中预训练语言条件的运动专家，并在融合场景与动作信息的 Transformer 结构中，提升真实仿人机器人全身操作的能力和数据效率。
summary_zh: 人形全身操作需要协调的全身动力学，然而来自目标机器人的大规模轨迹数据采集成本高昂且难以扩展。相比之下，来自人类和人形机器人的全身运动数据则十分丰富，尽管此类数据无法直接用作特定具身形态的机器人动作。本研究探索这些可扩展的运动资源是否能为人形世界-动作建模提供可迁移的预测先验。我们提出WholeBodyWAM，一种人形世界-动作模型，它在目标机器人训练之前从大规模异构运动中学习全身动力学。我们构建了UniMotion-4K，一个涵盖超过4000小时运动的语料库，数据来源包括人类视频、原生3D运动数据集以及异构人形机器人平台，并将这些多样化来源统一规范化到一个统一的运动空间中。随后，我们预训练一个语言条件化的运动专家，用于在无目标机器人动作监督的情况下预测未来的全身运动。在机器人后训练阶段，预训练的运动专家通过非对称混合变换器（MoT）注意力机制与视觉专家和动作专家集成，使预测性场景动力学和全身运动能够共同指导特定具身形态的动作生成。实验表明，WholeBodyWAM能够持续受益于运动预训练规模的增大，提升未来运动预测能力和下游任务表现，并有效迁移至真实世界的人形操作任务。此外，预训练的运动先验在目标机器人演示数据有限的条件下显著提升了数据效率。

title: Not All Layers Need Tuning: Diagnosing and Directing Adaptation in Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Fine-tuning a Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model for a new deployment environment is expensive, yet most methods apply uniform-capacity adapters to every network region as if every region requires equal adjustment. This paper tests that assumption on five architecturally diverse VLAs (OpenVLA-OFT, $π_0$, SmolVLA, DTP, Octo; 93M-7B parameters). Measuring per-region adaptation cost as normalized parameter displacement under region-isolated fine-tuning reveals an adaptation spectrum in which appearance shifts concentrate cost in the vision encoder, instruction shifts in the language backbone, and novel-object shifts in the vision encoder together with the action head, across all five architectures. To exploit this structure, we introduce a pipeline that observes, diagnoses, allocates, and adapts. From ten unlabeled target observations and without fine-tuning, the diagnostic estimates per-region cost by combining reference-free gradient and Monte Carlo Dropout signals with a Centered Kernel Alignment score against a cached source reference; the allocator converts the estimates into variable-rank LoRA adapters under a parameter budget and freezes well-calibrated regions; and standard LoRA fine-tuning trains the resulting adapters. The diagnostic ranks regions within each deployment at a median Spearman of 0.91, and the allocation matches or exceeds uniform LoRA at every budget we tested on LIBERO and CALVIN. On a physical xArm-7, the pipeline matches full fine-tuning under an instruction-wording shift with 0.04% of its trainable parameters, and on five held-out scenes evaluated without retraining it leads every baseline, with 11-23 successes of 30 rollouts against 8-18 for the strongest parameter-efficient baseline at equal or larger budgets and 2-11 for full fine-tuning. These results suggest that adaptation cost in VLAs is structured enough to measure before fine-tuning begins.
tldr: This paper shows that adaptation cost in VLA models is structured by shift type and architecture, and introduces a pipeline that estimates per-region adaptation needs from unlabeled observations to efficiently allocate LoRA adapters, matching or exceeding uniform fine-tuning with far fewer parameters on simulated and real robot tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文证明VLA模型中的适应成本按迁移类型和架构具有结构，并提出一种流水线，从无标注观测中估计各区域适应需求以分配LoRA适配器，在模拟和真实机器人任务上以极少参数达到或超越均匀微调。
summary_zh: 针对新部署环境对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型进行微调成本高昂，然而大多数方法对每个网络区域统一施加相同容量的适配器，仿佛每个区域都需要同等程度的调整。本文在五个架构各异的VLA模型（OpenVLA-OFT、$π_0$、SmolVLA、DTP、Octo；参数规模93M-7B）上检验了这一假设。通过区域隔离微调下归一化参数位移来衡量各区域适配成本，我们发现了一种适配谱系：在所有五种架构中，外观变化将成本集中于视觉编码器，指令变化集中于语言主干，而新物体变化则同时涉及视觉编码器与动作头。为利用这一结构特征，我们提出了一条包含观察、诊断、分配与适配的完整流程。基于十个无标签目标观测且无需微调，诊断模块通过结合无参考梯度、蒙特卡洛Dropout信号以及针对缓存源参考计算的中心核对齐得分来估计各区域成本；分配模块在参数预算约束下将估计值转化为可变秩LoRA适配器，并冻结校准良好的区域；随后通过标准LoRA微调训练所得适配器。在每个部署场景中，诊断模块对各区域排序的中位Spearman相关系数为0.91；在LIBERO和CALVIN上，我们测试的每个预算水平下，该分配策略均达到或超过均匀LoRA的性能。在物理xArm-7机器人上，面对指令措辞变化，该流程仅用全量微调0.04%的可训练参数即达到与其相当的表现；在五个未经重新训练即进行评估的预留场景中，该方法在所有基线中领先，30次 rollout 中取得11-23次成功，而最强参数高效基线在相同或更大预算下为8-18次，全量微调为2-11次。这些结果表明，VLA中的适配成本具有足够的结构性，可以在微调开始前即可被度量。

title: PointZero: 3D Point Track Completion for Learning Transferable 3D Dynamics
summary: World models endow perceptual systems with the ability to predict how scenes evolve under interaction. They are most beneficial when trained on diverse volumes of data, to instill a rich prior into downstream applications. Existing methods typically require robot action labels to learn action-conditioned 3D dynamics, which excludes web video data from the training pool. We study 3D point track completion as a pre-training objective for learning transferable 3D dynamics without robot data. Given a single RGB-D observation and sparse partial 3D trajectories (tracks), we predict future 3D tracks of all observed points. We show this objective produces a rich 3D dynamics prior, without requiring robot action labels. We contribute a diverse dataset of 2.9 million synthetic frames spanning deformable, articulated, and rigid objects, and use it to train PointZero. We show that a flexible and expressive transformer, PointZero, outperforms prior methods on the same data. We demonstrate the utility of our pre-training objective by post-training PointZero for two downstream applications: (1) action-conditioned 3D dynamics prediction and (2) imitation learning. When fine-tuned to condition on end-effector pose, PointZero outperforms the baselines on the recent PGND 3D dynamics benchmark. When fine-tuned to predict robot actions and 3D tracks, PointZero outperforms or matches the baselines on 6/7 simulated and real-world robot manipulation tasks. We furthermore evaluate training PointZero from scratch to isolate the benefits of our proposed architecture from those of our proposed pre-training objective and dataset. We release the dataset, checkpoints, and full training recipe.
tldr: PointZero proposes 3D point track completion as a label-free pretraining objective for learning transferable 3D dynamics, enabling action-conditioned dynamics prediction and imitation learning for robotic manipulation without robot action labels during pretraining.
tldr_zh: PointZero 提出了以 3D 点轨迹补全作为无需标签的预训练目标，用于学习可迁移的 3D 动态模型，从而在预训练阶段无需机器人动作标签即可支持动作条件下的动态预测和模仿学习。
summary_zh: 世界模型赋予感知系统预测场景在交互作用下如何演化的能力。当在多样化的数据规模上进行训练时，这些模型最为有益，能够为下游应用注入丰富的先验知识。现有方法通常需要机器人动作标签来学习基于动作的条件化三维动力学，这导致网络视频数据被排除在训练池之外。我们研究了将三维点轨迹补全作为预训练目标，以在无需机器人数据的情况下学习可迁移的三维动力学。给定单一的RGB-D观测和稀疏的部分三维轨迹（轨迹点），我们预测所有观测点的未来三维轨迹。我们证明，该目标无需机器人动作标签即可产生丰富的三维动力学先验。我们贡献了一个多样化的数据集，包含290万帧合成图像，涵盖可变形物体、铰接物体和刚性物体，并利用该数据集训练了PointZero模型。我们证明，一个灵活且表达力强的Transformer模型PointZero在同数据上优于先前方法。我们通过将PointZero用于两个下游应用的后训练来展示预训练目标的实用性：（1）基于动作的条件化三维动力学预测和（2）模仿学习。当微调以末端执行器姿态为条件时，PointZero在最新的PGND三维动力学基准上优于基线方法。当微调以预测机器人动作和三维轨迹时，PointZero在6/7个模拟和真实世界机器人操作任务中优于或匹配基线方法。此外，我们还评估了从头训练PointZero的效果，以将我们提出的架构的优势与我们提出的预训练目标和数据集的优势分离开来。我们发布了数据集、检查点和完整的训练方案。

title: In-Context Robot Learning with VLM Agents
summary: Enabling robots to adapt to unfamiliar environments as readily as humans remains a moonshot goal of embodied AI. No finite collection of demonstrations can cover every task and situation a robot will encounter, making the ability to learn from context at deployment essential for generalization. Such in-context learning (ICL), however, remains largely beyond the reach of existing robotic policies. The broad agentic capabilities of commercial vision-language models (VLMs), such as GPT-6 Astra, raise a compelling question: can these models learn from demonstrations, examples, and interaction feedback, then translate that information into executable and verifiable robot behavior from a new initial state without gradient updates or persistent changes to task-specific parameters? We introduce GPT-Policy, a general-agent framework for in-context robot learning. GPT-Policy integrates a context compiler that preserves task-relevant visual transitions, a VLM that proposes robot-tool actions, and a constrained controller that verifies and executes each action and reports its outcome. We evaluate its reliability and limitations through task success and efficiency metrics, matched comparisons across models, and controlled context ablations. In real-robot trials, human video demonstrations improve task completion even without robot action labels, while aligned action references yield further gains on contact-sensitive tasks. These findings position GPT-Policy as a step toward robot adaptation through in-context learning, providing an empirical foundation for translating the general-purpose capabilities of VLMs into physical behavior and clarifying the challenges that must be overcome for reliable deployment.
tldr: The paper introduces GPT-Policy, a framework that uses a commercial VLM (GPT-6 Astra) for in-context robot learning, enabling adaptation from demonstrations and feedback without gradient updates, validated on real robots.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了 GPT-Policy 框架，利用商业 VLM 进行上下文机器人学习，无需梯度更新即可从演示和反馈中适应，并在真实机器人上验证。
summary_zh: 让机器人像人类一样自如地适应陌生环境，仍是具身智能领域一个远景目标。任何有限的示范集合都无法覆盖机器人将遇到的所有任务与情境，因此，在部署阶段具备从上下文中学习的能力，对于实现泛化至关重要。然而，这种情境学习（ICL）在很大程度上仍超出当前机器人策略的能力范围。商用视觉语言模型（如GPT-6 Astra）所展现的广泛智能体能力，引发了一个值得关注的问题：这些模型能否从示范、示例及交互反馈中学习，并将所学信息转化为可从新初始状态执行且可验证的机器人行为，且无需梯度更新或对任务特定参数进行持久修改？为此，我们提出了GPT-Policy，一个面向机器人情境学习的通用智能体框架。GPT-Policy整合了保留任务相关视觉转换的上下文编译器、提出机器人工具动作的视觉语言模型，以及一个约束控制器，用于验证并执行每个动作并反馈其结果。我们通过任务成功率与效率指标、跨模型的匹配对比以及受控的上下文消融实验，评估了该框架的可靠性及其局限性。在真实机器人试验中，即使没有机器人动作标签，人类视频示范也能提升任务完成率，而对接触敏感的任务，对齐的动作参考进一步带来了性能提升。这些发现使GPT-Policy朝着通过情境学习实现机器人适应的方向迈出了一步，为将视觉语言模型的通用能力转化为物理行为提供了实证基础，同时也厘清了实现可靠部署所需克服的挑战。

title: Dreaming the Sound of Contact: Leveraging Video and Audio Generation for Zero-Shot Force-Aware Manipulation and Data Generation
summary: Video generation models have advanced rapidly and can now synthesize plausible videos of robot manipulation from image and text prompts. Recent work extracts robot actions directly from such generated videos, but the result is purely kinematic and lacks force information, causing failures in contact-rich tasks where appropriate contact forces are essential for success. We present a pipeline that jointly leverages generated video and audio to derive motion trajectories and desired-force profiles. The force profile is shaped by the loudness of the generated contact sound, and we execute the resulting force-aware trajectories on a Franka robot using a closed-loop force regulator. We evaluate our pipeline on multiple tasks that require making contact and demonstrate successful zero-shot manipulation where a kinematic-only baseline fails. We also show that the pipeline can be used as a data generation engine to train policies that achieve the tasks in a closed-loop manner. Project website, videos, and dataset: https://dreamingcontactsound.github.io/
tldr: This paper introduces a zero-shot force-aware manipulation pipeline that jointly uses generated video and audio to derive motion trajectories and desired-force profiles, executed on a Franka robot and also used for data generation to train closed-loop policies.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种零样本力感知操作流水线，联合利用生成的视频和音频来推导运动轨迹和期望力轮廓，并在弗兰卡机器人上执行，同时用于数据生成以训练闭环策略。
summary_zh: 视频生成模型近年来发展迅速，现已能够根据图像和文本提示，合成逼真的机器人操作视频。近期研究尝试直接从这类生成视频中提取机器人动作，但所得结果仅包含运动学信息，缺乏力信息，导致在需要适当接触力才能成功完成的接触密集型任务中失败。我们提出了一种流程，联合利用生成的视频和音频，推导出运动轨迹及期望力分布。力分布由生成接触声的响度塑造，并通过闭环力调节器在Franka机器人上执行所得的力感知轨迹。我们在多项需要接触的任务上评估了该流程，并展示了在仅依赖运动学信息的基线方法失败的情况下，零样本操作的成功实现。我们还表明，该流程可用作数据生成引擎，训练策略以闭环方式完成各项任务。项目网站、视频及数据集：https://dreamingcontactsound.github.io/

title: rMuscle: Robotic Muscle Memory for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Model Inference
summary:
Factory work is a promising early scenario for embodied AI: assigning repetitive manual jobs to robots has clear economic payoff, and a structured station keeps the jobs tractable for current policies. Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models now dominate as the policy paradigm for these robots. The inference latency of VLA models directly affects robot responsiveness and motion smoothness. However, existing VLA inference frameworks do not fully exploit the characteristics of embodied workloads or account for the distinct bottlenecks across different stages of VLA inference.
  In this paper, we first characterize embodied workloads and identify substantial task similarity across repeated robot executions. We further find that such similarity extends beyond observations and action trajectories to internal model states. Drawing on these observations, we present rMuscle, a real-time VLA inference framework inspired by human muscle memory. It exploits cross-execution similarity through a dual-phase muscle-memory cache. The Context Cache reuses visual-token outputs to reduce computation, while the Action Cache reuses neuron activation patterns to reduce weight accesses. We keep both the cache memory footprint and access overhead low through online cache recomputation, sliding-window cache retrieval, and mask sharing across consecutive denoising steps. rMuscle achieves 1.29-1.42X speedup on RTX 4090 and Jetson Thor across LIBERO, RoboTwin, and physical manipulation tasks, while maintaining the original success rates on real-world robots.
tldr: rMuscle is a real-time inference framework for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models that exploits cross-execution similarities via a dual-phase muscle-memory cache, achieving 1.29-1.42X speedup on real robots while maintaining success rates.
tldr_zh: rMuscle 是一种针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的实时推理框架，通过利用跨执行相似性的双阶段肌肉记忆缓存，在真实机器人上实现 1.29-1.42 倍加速，同时保持成功率不变。
summary_zh:
工厂作业是具身智能一个前景广阔的早期应用场景：将重复性人工任务分配给机器人具有显著的经济效益，且结构化的工位使当前策略能够胜任这些任务。视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型如今已成为这类机器人策略范式的主流选择。VLA模型的推理延迟直接影响机器人的响应速度和运动平滑性。然而，现有的VLA推理框架未能充分利用具身工作负载的特性，也未考虑VLA推理不同阶段所面临的差异化瓶颈。

本文首先对具身工作负载进行了特征分析，发现重复执行的机器人任务之间存在显著的相似性。进一步研究表明，这种相似性不仅体现在观测数据和动作轨迹上，还延伸至模型内部状态。基于这些发现，我们提出了rMuscle——一种受人类肌肉记忆启发的实时VLA推理框架。该框架通过双阶段肌肉记忆缓存利用跨执行相似性：上下文缓存（Context Cache）复用视觉token输出以减少计算量，动作缓存（Action Cache）复用神经元激活模式以减少权重访问。通过在线缓存重计算、滑动窗口缓存检索以及连续去噪步骤间的掩码共享机制，我们同时保持了较低的缓存内存占用和访问开销。在LIBERO、RoboTwin及物理操作任务上，rMuscle在RTX 4090和Jetson Thor平台上实现了1.29-1.42倍的加速，同时在真实机器人上保持了原有的任务成功率。

title: Learning Holistic Whole-Body Loco-Manipulation with a Bipedal Mobile Manipulator
summary: Bipedal loco-manipulation enables robots to interact with objects beyond the nominal workspace of their arms by coordinating locomotion and manipulation. Realizing this capability requires a low-level whole-body controller that translates task-level manipulation goals into coordinated arm and leg motions while maintaining balance. We present a unified whole-body controller trained with reinforcement learning that directly maps 6-DoF end-effector targets to coordinated actions for the bipedal base and robotic arm. Given only an end-effector target, the learned controller autonomously coordinates reaching, postural adaptation, and stepping without explicit base-velocity or footstep commands. A reward-gating strategy regulates the trade-offs among end-effector tracking, locomotion, and balance during training, while a temporal context estimator combines windowed Transformer encoding, recurrent GRU memory, and auxiliary dynamics prediction to extract dynamics-relevant information from observation history. Real-robot experiments demonstrate that the same controller supports reaching, postural adaptation, and stepping under commands from VR teleoperation, a learned diffusion policy, and scripted trajectories, providing a common end-effector interface for diverse manipulation tasks.
tldr: This paper presents a unified whole-body controller trained with reinforcement learning that maps 6-DoF end-effector targets to coordinated actions for a bipedal mobile manipulator, enabling loco-manipulation for reaching, postural adaptation, and stepping, demonstrated on real hardware via multiple interfaces.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一个基于强化学习的统一全身控制器，将6自由度末端执行器目标映射为双足移动机械臂的协调动作，实现伸够、姿态调整和迈步等移动操作，并在真实机器人上通过多种接口验证。
summary_zh: 双足移动操作通过协调运动与操作，使机器人能够在手臂标称工作空间之外与物体进行交互。实现这一能力需要一种低层全身控制器，将任务级操作目标转化为协调的手臂与腿部运动，同时保持平衡。我们提出了一种基于强化学习训练的统一全身控制器，直接将六自由度末端执行器目标映射为双足基底与机械臂的协调动作。仅给定末端执行器目标，学习得到的控制器便能自主协调伸展、姿态调整与迈步，而无需显式的基础速度或落脚点指令。一种奖励门控策略在训练过程中调节末端执行器跟踪、运动与平衡之间的权衡，而时间上下文估计器则结合窗口化Transformer编码、循环GRU记忆及辅助动力学预测，从观测历史中提取与动力学相关的信息。真实机器人实验表明，同一控制器能够在VR遥操作、学习到的扩散策略及脚本化轨迹的指令下支持伸展、姿态调整与迈步，为多种操作任务提供了统一的末端执行器接口。

title: KINO: A Keyframe Interface for VLM Planning and Whole-Body Control in Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
summary: Humanoid loco-manipulation requires robots to interpret task instructions and scene semantics while executing coordinated whole-body motions. We propose a hierarchical framework that uses motion keyframes as an intermediate representation between Vision-Language Model (VLM) planning and Reinforcement Learning (RL) control. Each keyframe specifies a target whole-body robot pose and, when applicable, an object pose. Given a language instruction, scene observations, and execution feedback, the VLM selects successive task-relevant keyframes from a predefined library. The selected keyframes are retargeted to the current scene to account for object poses and dimensions. A keyframe-conditioned whole-body policy then generates joint-level actions to reach these goals. We introduce a saliency-based keyframe sampling strategy for low-level policy training that improves end-to-end task success rate from 44% to 92% when using sparse VLM keyframes. We evaluate our framework on object pickup, transport, and placement tasks in simulation and on a Unitree G1 humanoid. The system successfully performs both one- and two-handed manipulation and generalises to placement locations beyond the training reference data.
tldr: This paper presents a hierarchical framework for humanoid loco-manipulation, using keyframes as an intermediate representation between VLM planning and RL-based whole-body control, achieving high success rates in simulation and on a Unitree G1 humanoid.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于人形机器人移动操作的分层框架，以关键帧作为VLM规划与RL全身控制之间的中间表示，在仿真和Unitree G1人形机器人上实现了高成功率。
summary_zh: 人形机器人全身操控任务要求机器人能够理解任务指令与场景语义，同时执行协调的全身运动。我们提出一种分层框架，以运动关键帧作为视觉-语言模型（VLM）规划与强化学习（RL）控制之间的中间表示。每个关键帧指定一个目标全身机器人姿态，并在适用时包含物体姿态。给定语言指令、场景观测及执行反馈后，VLM从预定义的关键帧库中依次选择与任务相关的关键帧。所选关键帧会被重定向至当前场景，以适配物体的姿态与尺寸。随后，一个由关键帧条件化的全身控制策略生成关节级动作以达成这些目标。我们提出一种基于显著性的关键帧采样策略用于底层策略训练，在仅使用稀疏VLM关键帧的情况下，将端到端任务成功率从44%提升至92%。我们在仿真环境及Unitree G1人形机器人上，对物体抓取、搬运和放置任务进行了框架评估。该系统能够成功执行单臂及双臂操控，并泛化至训练参考数据之外的放置位置。

title: AdaGeoVLN: Selective Geometry Across Representation Depth and Navigation Time for Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Vision-language navigation requires aligning language with visual observations while maintaining spatial understanding over time. Geometry foundation models (GFMs) expose intermediate representations throughout their hierarchy, but how navigation policies should use these features and retain historical geometric evidence remains unresolved. We introduce \method{}, a streaming VLN framework that addresses these questions across \textbf{representation depth} and \textbf{navigation time}. Hierarchical GFM--VLM fusion couples earlier, intermediate, and later GFM representations to successive policy stages instead of repeatedly injecting a terminal feature. Navigation-aware GFM memory retains historical VGGT global-attention KV states according to instruction relevance, geometric confidence, and transition novelty under a bounded per-layer budget. Retained states provide geometric context for subsequent observations before fusion with the policy. Across R2R-CE and RxR-CE, \method{} achieves strong performance using a single RGB stream without additional navigation-specific external data. Controlled ablations show that multi-depth coupling substantially outperforms repeated terminal-feature injection at matched fusion locations. Bounded navigation-aware retention preserves navigation performance while considerably reducing GFM-KV memory relative to larger-memory temporal retention. These findings support jointly examining the geometric representations exposed to the policy and the historical evidence retained for future inference. Code will be released upon acceptance at https://humanoid-research.github.io/adageovln/.
tldr: The paper proposes AdaGeoVLN, a streaming VLN framework that fuses hierarchical geometry foundation model (GFM) features across representation depth and retains historical GFM KV states under a bounded budget, achieving strong performance on R2R-CE and RxR-CE with a single RGB stream.
tldr_zh: 本文提出AdaGeoVLN，一种流式视觉语言导航框架，在表征深度上分层融合几何基础模型（GFM）特征，并在导航时间上以有限预算保留历史GFM KV状态，在R2R-CE和RxR-CE数据集上仅使用单RGB流即取得强性能。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言导航要求将语言与视觉观察对齐，同时随时间保持空间理解能力。几何基础模型（GFMs）在其层级结构中暴露了中间表示，但导航策略应如何使用这些特征以及如何保留历史几何证据，仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。我们提出\method{}，一种流式VLN框架，从\textbf{表示深度}和\textbf{导航时间}两个维度解决上述问题。层级化GFM--VLM融合将GFM的早期、中期和后期表示分别耦合到策略的不同阶段，而不是反复注入单一终端特征。导航感知的GFM记忆根据指令相关性、几何置信度和转换新颖性，在每层有界预算下保留历史VGGT全局注意力键值状态。保留的状态在后续观测与策略融合之前，为其提供几何上下文。在R2R-CE和RxR-CE上，\method{}仅使用单一RGB流、无需额外导航专用外部数据即可取得优异性能。控制消融实验表明，在匹配的融合位置上，多深度耦合显著优于重复终端特征注入。有界导航感知保留在显著减少GFM键值记忆相对于更大记忆时间保留的同时，保持了导航性能。这些发现支持对暴露给策略的几何表示以及为未来推理保留的历史证据进行联合考察。代码将在论文接收后于https://humanoid-research.github.io/adageovln/发布。

title: Gated Residual Body-Hand Coordination for Whole-Body Humanoid Teleoperation
summary: Whole-body humanoid teleoperation commonly combines a motion-tracking policy with a separate dexterous-hand retargeter. However, independently generated commands do not explicitly preserve body-hand geometric relations, leading to mismatches in relative wrist poses and fingertip positions during bimanual interaction. We present a gated residual coordination framework that keeps both modules frozen and applies bounded corrections to their outputs. A motion-conditioned action gate allocates correction authority across joint groups, while reference-geometry-dependent reward gates emphasize relevant interaction objectives during training. To establish the nominal body controller on Agile One, we introduce multi-pose morphology calibration that jointly estimates triaxial scales and effector-local offsets, together with staged motion dataset curation for training a SONIC-based tracker. The residual policy uses human motion references, initial commands, and robot proprioception without explicit object or contact observations. In simulation, it reduces wrist and fingertip geometry errors by 39.2-56.3% over direct composition on held-out GRAB motions, while preserving whole-body tracking on AMASS, with success rates of 89.03% without residual coordination and 89.29% with it. Ablations characterize the contributions of reward gating, adaptive correction authority, and separate body and hand correction heads.
tldr: This paper presents a gated residual coordination framework for whole-body humanoid teleoperation that corrects body-hand geometric mismatches by applying bounded corrections to the outputs of frozen motion-tracking and hand-retargeting modules, reducing wrist and fingertip errors while preserving whole-body tracking.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于全身人形遥操作的门控残差协调框架，通过对冻结的运动跟踪和手部重定向模块输出施加有界修正，纠正身体-手部几何不匹配，同时保持全身跟踪性能。
summary_zh: 全身人形遥操作通常将运动跟踪策略与独立的灵巧手重定向器结合使用。然而，独立生成的指令并未显式保持身体与手部之间的几何关系，导致在双臂交互过程中手腕姿态和指尖位置出现不匹配。我们提出了一种门控残差协调框架，该框架保持两个模块冻结，并对其输出施加有界修正。运动条件化的动作门控在关节组间分配修正权限，而参考几何相关的奖励门控则在训练中强调相关的交互目标。为了在Agile One上建立标称身体控制器，我们引入了多姿态形态学标定方法，该方法联合估计三轴尺度和执行器局部偏移，并配合分阶段运动数据集整理以训练基于SONIC的跟踪器。残差策略使用人体运动参考、初始命令和机器人本体感觉，无需显式的物体或接触观测。在仿真中，该方法在保留的GRAB动作上相比直接组合将手腕和指尖几何误差降低了39.2%-56.3%，同时在AMASS上保持了全身跟踪性能，无残差协调时的成功率为89.03%，有残差协调时为89.29%。消融实验表征了奖励门控、自适应修正权限以及独立的身体和手部修正分支各自的贡献。

title: Grasping by interconnection: robust closing motions from coarse object templates
summary: Dexterous robot hands must often grasp objects whose shape, size, and pose are known only approximately. Grasp planners typically require accurate object models or correct errors with feedback, but how much inaccuracy a closing motion can tolerate on its own remains unclear. To address this question, we designed a motion planner based on four principles: a coarse template of the object, human grasp types, an object-centric interaction, and compliant, sliding contacts instead of prescribed contact points. This paper presents the planner, implemented through virtual model control, and its evaluation on a Shadow Dexterous Hand. Without feedback, the planned closing motions tolerated size errors of about 1cm and pose errors of several centimeters and tens of degrees, a wider range than a state-of-the-art data-driven planner in 25 of 27 tested conditions. They also grasped 82.5% of 80 everyday objects and succeeded within an autonomous pipeline. Robustness can thus be designed into the closing motion itself, rather than left only to feedback. This planner opens a path toward reliable manipulation in uncertain settings, which we will pursue by combining it with adaptive feedback control on the physical hand.
tldr: This paper presents a motion planner for dexterous robotic hands that uses coarse object templates and compliant, sliding contacts to generate robust grasping closing motions, achieving tolerance to size and pose errors without feedback and validated on a Shadow Dexterous Hand.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种用于灵巧机器手的运动规划器，利用粗略物体模板和柔性滑动接触生成鲁棒的抓取闭合动作，在无反馈条件下容忍尺寸和位姿误差，并在Shadow灵巧手上验证。
summary_zh: 灵巧机器手通常需要抓取形状、尺寸和姿态仅大致已知的物体。抓取规划器通常需要精确的物体模型或通过反馈来纠正误差，但闭合动作本身能够容忍多大的不准确性仍不清楚。为回答这一问题，我们设计了一种基于四项原则的运动规划器：物体的粗略模板、人类抓取类型、以物体为中心的交互，以及柔顺的滑动接触而非预设接触点。本文介绍了该规划器，通过虚拟模型控制实现，并在Shadow灵巧手上进行了评估。在无反馈条件下，规划的闭合动作能够容忍约1厘米的尺寸误差以及数厘米和数十度的姿态误差，在27种测试条件中的25种下，其容忍范围优于最先进的数据驱动规划器。此外，该规划器成功抓取了80个日常物体中的82.5%，并在自主流程中顺利完成。因此，鲁棒性可以被设计进闭合动作本身，而非仅依赖反馈。该规划器为不确定环境下的可靠操作开辟了路径，我们将通过将其与物理手上的自适应反馈控制相结合来进一步推进这一方向。

title: PASSAGE: Scaling Scene-Aligned Motion Learning for Perceptive Humanoid Traversal in Cluttered Environments
summary: Humanoid robots can step over, squeeze past, and duck under obstacles, but learning to select and coordinate these behaviors from onboard perception remains challenging. Many existing approaches rely on task-specific reinforcement-learning objectives or curated motion libraries, making broad behavioral coverage costly. We present PASSAGE, a perception-conditioned planner--tracker framework for humanoid traversal. Using virtual reality and inertial motion capture, we collect 100 h of scene-aligned human motion across 1,500 cluttered scenes. A conditional flow-matching planner generates short-horizon references from motion history, a local destination, and a robot-centric multi-layer elevation map, while a perceptive whole-body tracker executes them at 50 Hz with geometric feedback. Real-time chunking promotes inter-chunk consistency, and planner-side RL post-training under the frozen tracker further improves closed-loop performance. Without skill annotations or obstacle-specific policies, one planner--tracker pair selects and composes traversal behaviors across unseen geometries. In simulation, component ablations quantify the contribution of each stage. Across three independent training seeds, scaling captured data from 6 to 100 h increases mean contact-free success from 48.1% to 68.9% on held-out scenes, while the final model with validated scene augmentation reaches 70.3%. The fully onboard system integrates egocentric 3D LiDAR perception, online occupancy mapping, 6.25 Hz planning, and 50 Hz control on a Jetson AGX Orin; tests across 50 unseen physical layouts demonstrate traversal without prebuilt maps or offboard computation.
tldr: PASSAGE presents a perception-conditioned planner-tracker framework that leverages 100 hours of scene-aligned human motion data and conditional flow-matching to enable humanoid robots to autonomously select and compose traversal behaviors in cluttered environments, achieving 70.3% contact-free success on held-out scenes and demonstrating fully onboard deployment.
tldr_zh: PASSAGE 提出了一种感知条件化的规划器-跟踪器框架，利用100小时场景对齐的人类运动数据和条件流匹配，使人形机器人在杂乱环境中自主选择和组合穿越行为，在保留场景上实现70.3%的无接触成功率，并展示了全板载部署。
summary_zh: 人形机器人能够跨过、侧身挤过并在障碍物下匍匐通过，但如何从机载感知中学习选择并协调这些行为仍然具有挑战性。许多现有方法依赖于特定任务下的强化学习目标函数或精心设计的动作库，导致广泛的行为覆盖成本高昂。我们提出了PASSAGE，一种用于人形机器人穿越的感知条件化规划器-跟踪器框架。利用虚拟现实和惯性动作捕捉技术，我们收集了覆盖1,500个杂乱场景、共计100小时、与场景对齐的人体运动数据。条件流匹配规划器根据运动历史、局部目的地以及以机器人为中心的多层高程图生成短时参考轨迹，而具有感知能力的全身跟踪器以50 Hz频率结合几何反馈执行这些轨迹。实时分块处理促进了块间一致性，规划器侧在冻结跟踪器条件下的强化学习后训练进一步提升了闭环性能。无需技能标注或针对特定障碍物的策略，单一的规划器-跟踪器组合即可在未见过的几何环境中选择并组合穿越行为。在仿真中，组件消融实验量化了各阶段的贡献。在三个独立训练种子下，将采集数据规模从6小时扩展至100小时，在保留场景中的平均无接触成功率从48.1%提升至68.9%，而经过验证的场景增强后的最终模型达到了70.3%。完整的机载系统集成了以自我为中心的3D激光雷达感知、在线占据地图构建、6.25 Hz规划和50 Hz控制，运行于Jetson AGX Orin平台上；在50种未见过的物理布局中的测试证明，该系统无需预建地图或机外计算即可实现穿越。

title: Calibrated Probabilistic Obstruction Reasoning with Vision-Language Models for Grasping in Clutter
summary: Retrieving a target from clutter requires deciding whether to grasp the target, remove a blocker, or defer. Existing methods typically commit to a single obstruction graph or removal strategy, ignoring uncertainty across alternative scene interpretations. They also rely on miscalibrated vision-language model (VLM) predictions and can produce pairwise obstruction relations that are jointly inconsistent. Moreover, current approximations provide no guarantees about the impact of discarded hypotheses on the final decision. We propose CPOR-Grasp, a calibrated probabilistic obstruction-reasoning framework that propagates uncertainty from pairwise evidence to action decisions. CPOR-Grasp calibrates and fuses VLM, depth, and amodal-mask cues to estimate obstruction probabilities, induces a distribution over valid obstruction graphs, and marginalizes over these graphs to compute the likelihood that the target is accessible or that a given blocker should be removed. To make inference tractable, it retains only the highest-probability graphs and derives a total-variation bound on the discarded probability mass, enabling certified decisions, adaptive stopping, and principled deferral. On synthetic and real UNOBench scenes, CPOR-Grasp outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. Calibration error decreases from 0.1416 to 0.0185 on the Gemini Robotics backbone, while graph truncation matches exact inference on 99.74\% of decisions using 56 times fewer graphs. In real-world experiments, CPOR-Grasp achieves a 77.8\% average success rate, surpassing SOTA baselines.
tldr: CPOR-Grasp introduces a calibrated probabilistic obstruction-reasoning framework for vision-language models, enabling reliable grasping in clutter by explicitly modeling uncertainty across obstruction graph interpretations and providing certified decision guarantees with significantly reduced calibration error and improved success rates.
tldr_zh: CPOR-Grasp 提出了一种基于视觉语言模型的校准概率障碍推理框架，通过在遮挡图解释中显式建模不确定性并提供有保证的决策支持，显著降低了校准误差并提高了杂乱环境中的抓取成功率。
summary_zh: 从杂乱环境中抓取目标物体需要决策是直接抓取目标、移除障碍物还是延迟操作。现有方法通常依赖于单一的障碍图或移除策略，忽略了不同场景解读之间的不确定性。此外，这些方法依赖未校准的视觉语言模型预测，可能产生相互不一致的成对障碍关系，且当前近似方法无法保证被丢弃假设对最终决策的影响。我们提出CPOR-Grasp，一种校准的概率障碍推理框架，将成对证据的不确定性传播到行动决策中。CPOR-Grasp校准并融合视觉语言模型、深度和遮挡掩膜线索来估计障碍概率，在有效障碍图上诱导概率分布，并通过对这些图进行边缘化来计算目标可达或应移除特定障碍物的似然。为使推理可计算，该方法仅保留概率最高的图，并对丢弃的概率质量推导全变差界，从而实现可认证决策、自适应停止和原理性延迟。在合成和真实UNOBench场景中，CPOR-Grasp优于最先进基线方法。校准误差在Gemini Robotics骨干网络上从0.1416降至0.0185，而图截断使用少56倍的图即可在99.74%的决策中匹配精确推理。在真实世界实验中，CPOR-Grasp实现了77.8%的平均成功率，超越了最先进基线方法。

title: WeaveRL: Weaving Reconstruction into Scene-Aware Fabrics for Perceptive Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning allows robots to acquire complex skills, but producing policies for geometrically complex manipulation remains difficult. A promising approach is to learn on top of collision-avoidant controllers, such as geometric fabrics. However, these approaches have relied on static, hand-specified representations of the scene. Integrating active, online 3D perception into massively parallel RL training has so far been inaccessible. We introduce a GPU-accelerated method that reconstructs the scene as a collection of surfels across thousands of parallel simulation instances during active rollouts. This lets policies operate over sensor-derived, rather than hand-specified, geometry. On a suite of collision-dense manipulation tasks, our surfel fabrics enable policies to tackle geometrically complex scenes where primitive-based baselines fail, while maintaining sim-to-real transfer. Furthermore, policies learned with a scene-aware fabric are more robust to the introduction of novel geometry at test time, improving collision-free task completion under unseen obstacles from 35% to 61%. We release our reconstruction system, training code and test dataset to spur research in this direction.
tldr: WeaveRL introduces a GPU-accelerated method for online 3D scene reconstruction as surfels during parallel RL training, enabling policies built on geometric fabrics to handle collision-dense manipulation with improved robustness to novel geometry and sim-to-real transfer.
tldr_zh: WeaveRL 提出了一种在并行强化学习训练中，通过 GPU 加速的在线 3D 场景重建（surfels）方法，使基于几何织物的策略能够处理高碰撞密度操作任务，并提升对未知几何的鲁棒性和 sim-to-real 迁移能力。
summary_zh: 强化学习使机器人能够习得复杂技能，但为几何结构复杂的操作任务生成策略仍然颇具挑战。一种有前景的思路是在避碰控制器（如几何织物）之上进行学习。然而，现有方法依赖于静态、手工指定的场景表示。将主动的在线三维感知集成到大规模并行强化学习训练中，至今仍难以实现。我们提出一种GPU加速方法，在主动推演过程中，将场景重建为遍布数千个并行仿真实例的曲面元素集合。这使得策略能够基于传感器获取的几何信息而非手工指定的几何信息进行决策。在一系列碰撞密集的操作任务中，我们的曲面织物方法使策略能够应对基于基元的基线方法无法胜任的复杂几何场景，同时保持仿真到现实迁移的能力。此外，使用场景感知织物学习的策略在测试阶段对新增几何形状具有更强的鲁棒性，在未见障碍物下完成任务的无碰撞成功率从35%提升至61%。我们公开了重建系统、训练代码及测试数据集，以推动该方向的研究。

title: M$^3$P-R1: Reinforcement Learning for Large Language Model Guided Multi-Modal Motion Planning via MIP Code Generation
summary: Multi-Modal Motion Planning (M$^3$P) requires joint reasoning over continuous motions and discrete mode transitions, making it difficult to solve efficiently. For instance, a bipedal robot may walk to a target location and then use its arms to grasp an object. This scenario captures both mode transitions and continuous dynamics, yielding feasible paths that neither purely discrete nor continuous planners can handle. While Mixed-Integer Programming (MIP) offers a principled framework, constructing tractable formulations for non-convex problems is typically manual and domain-specific, especially in the approximate, discretization-based MIP regime needed for non-convex robotic tasks. We propose M$^3$P-R1, a reinforcement learning method that fine-tunes large language models (LLMs) to decompose M$^3$P tasks into MIP variables, constraints, and objectives. Instead of directly outputting answers, which are often prone to hallucination, the model generates executable Python code using MIP optimization libraries and constraint interfaces. This enables solver-backed execution for robust and verifiable solutions. Trained with an outcome-driven reward against the solver, M$^3$P-R1 learns to compose modality-level discretization primitives and synthesize cross-modal coupling constraints, producing executable MIP programs for complex M$^3$P tasks.
tldr: This paper introduces M³P-R1, a reinforcement learning method that fine-tunes LLMs to generate MIP code for solving multi-modal motion planning tasks, enabling solver-backed, verifiable robot motion plans.
tldr_zh: 本文提出M³P-R1，一种强化学习方法，微调LLM生成MIP代码以解决多模态运动规划任务，实现基于求解器的可验证机器人运动规划。
summary_zh: 多模态运动规划（M$^3$P）要求在连续运动与离散模式转换之间进行联合推理，这使得高效求解变得尤为困难。例如，一个双足机器人可能先步行至目标位置，再使用其手臂抓取物体。该场景同时涉及模式转换与连续动力学，由此产生的可行路径是纯离散或纯连续规划器均无法处理的。尽管混合整数规划（MIP）提供了一个原理性框架，但针对非凸问题构建可处理的数学表述通常依赖人工且局限于特定领域，尤其是在非凸机器人任务所需的基于离散化近似的MIP框架中。我们提出M$^3$P-R1，一种通过强化学习微调大型语言模型（LLMs）的方法，用于将M$^3$P任务分解为MIP变量、约束条件和目标函数。该方法并非直接输出答案（这类答案往往容易产生幻觉），而是生成使用MIP优化库和约束接口的可执行Python代码，从而实现基于求解器的执行，以获得稳健且可验证的解决方案。M$^3$P-R1以求解器的结果作为奖励进行训练，学习组合模态级离散化原语并合成跨模态耦合约束，从而为复杂的M$^3$P任务生成可执行的MIP程序。

title: VLA-ULAP: Interleaving Cloud VLA Calls with Ultra-Lightweight Local Action Prediction at the Edge
summary: Billion-parameter vision--language--action (VLA) policies demand substantial onboard power, while communication delays in remote inference hinder timely responses. We propose VLA-ULAP, which interleaves remote VLA calls with an Ultra-Lightweight Local Action Predictor (ULAP). With approximately 7.4M parameters including the frozen vision encoder, ULAP combines current views, proprioception, and executed action history to predict chunks in one pass. Trained independently, it requires no VLA hidden states, online verification, or server round trips. On Jetson Orin Nano, ULAP takes 19.9 ms and 0.183 J per inference, compared with 284.3 ms and 50.55 J for GR00T on RTX A6000. Across three simulated base-policy/benchmark pairs, selected operating points remove 48.8--76.7\% of VLA calls while retaining 95.0--97.5\% of the baseline success rate. Against local VLA-acceleration alternatives on VLA-JEPA, ULAP uses an estimated 49.2\% less inference time and 51.0\% less GPU energy per successful episode than ACT at comparable success rates, and 77.1\% less time and 79.9\% less energy than SP-VLA at equal success rates. Physical SO-101 experiments retain 95.2--100\% of the baseline success rate across seen and held-out placements while reducing inference time by an estimated 47.9--58.0\% and inference-device energy by 52.1--62.5\%, based on successful-episode call counts and measured device costs. Faster responses also improve dynamic-task success rates: in latency-aware LIBERO-Safety simulation, VLA-ULAP exceeds $π_{0.5}$ by 11.0 and 15.5 percentage points on two tasks while approximately halving VLA calls.
tldr: VLA-ULAP interleaves cloud VLA calls with an ultra-lightweight local action predictor to reduce latency and energy on edge robots while preserving success rates across simulations and physical experiments.
tldr_zh: VLA-ULAP将云端VLA调用与超轻量局部动作预测器交错，降低边缘机器人的延迟和能耗，同时在仿真和物理实验中保持成功率。
summary_zh: 十亿参数级别的视觉-语言-行动（VLA）策略需要大量的机载算力，而远程推理中的通信延迟则阻碍了及时响应。我们提出VLA-ULAP，它将远程VLA调用与超轻量级本地行动预测器（ULAP）交替结合。ULAP包含约740万参数（含冻结的视觉编码器），利用当前视图、本体感觉以及已执行的行动历史，一次性预测行动块。由于采用独立训练，ULAP无需VLA隐藏状态、在线验证或服务器往返通信。在Jetson Orin Nano上，ULAP每次推理耗时19.9毫秒，能耗0.183焦耳，而GR00T在RTX A6000上分别需要284.3毫秒和50.55焦耳。在三个模拟基座策略/基准测试组合中，所选工作点移除了48.8%至76.7%的VLA调用，同时保持了基线成功率的95.0%至97.5%。在VLA-JEPA上，与本地VLA加速替代方案相比，在相当成功率下，ULAP每次成功任务估计比ACT减少49.2%的推理时间和51.0%的GPU能耗；在与SP-VLA成功率持平的情况下，减少77.1%的时间和79.9%的能耗。物理SO-101实验在已知和未见过布局中保持了基线成功率的95.2%至100%，同时基于成功任务调用计数和实测设备成本，估计减少推理时间47.9%至58.0%，推理设备能耗减少52.1%至62.5%。更快的响应也提升了动态任务的成功率：在具有延迟感知的LIBERO-Safety仿真中，VLA-ULAP在两个任务上分别比π₀.₅高出11.0和15.5个百分点，同时VLA调用量约减半。

title: FIERCE: From Generalist Robot Policies to Fast Specialists via Progress-Failure Feedback
summary: Generalist robot policies offer useful initialization, but refining compact specialists through limited physical interaction requires informative learning feedback. We present FIERCE, a generalist-initialized reinforcement learning framework centered on a unified, task-adaptive progress-failure evaluator. Its architecture shares an observation-language representation between an observed-progress head and an action-conditioned latent predictor whose past and current predictions feed a causal sequence head for task-failure estimation. Joint supervision from progress and preference labels, synchronized commands and observations, and terminal outcomes trains the evaluator; target-task rollouts support adaptation and calibration. Fixed evaluator snapshots provide progress shaping and failure-risk penalties alongside independently verified terminal rewards, while evaluator and policy updates alternate as new experience is collected. Refinement requires neither continued generalist action queries nor a dedicated target-task simulator or manually annotated dense rewards. Only the compact specialist is retained at deployment. The evaluation separates feedback quality, policy-learning efficiency, and deployment cost across simulation and two contact-rich real tasks. Code, model weights, and data-restoration tools are released at https://github.com/ar-mine/FIERCE.
tldr: FIERCE introduces a generalist-initialized reinforcement learning framework that uses a progress-failure evaluator to efficiently specialize robot policies with limited physical interaction, validated in simulation and real contact-rich tasks.
tldr_zh: FIERCE 提出了一种以通用策略初始化的强化学习框架，通过进度-失败评估器在有限的物理交互下高效特化机器人策略，并在仿真和真实接触丰富任务中验证。
summary_zh: 通用型机器人策略提供了有用的初始化，但通过有限的物理交互来精炼紧凑型专用策略，需要信息丰富的学习反馈。我们提出了FIERCE，一个以通用型策略初始化的强化学习框架，其核心是一个统一的、任务自适应的进度-失败评估器。该架构在观测进度头与动作条件潜变量预测器之间共享观测-语言表示，后者的过去与当前预测结果被输入因果序列头，用于任务失败估计。来自进度标签与偏好标签的联合监督、同步的命令与观测以及终止结果共同训练该评估器；目标任务回合支持其适应与校准。固定的评估器快照提供进度塑形与失败风险惩罚，辅以独立验证的终止奖励，同时评估器与策略更新在新经验收集过程中交替进行。精炼过程既不需要持续的通用型策略动作查询，也不需要专用的目标任务模拟器或人工标注的稠密奖励。在部署时仅保留紧凑型专用策略。评估在仿真环境及两项接触丰富的真实任务中，分别衡量了反馈质量、策略学习效率与部署成本。代码、模型权重及数据恢复工具已发布于https://github.com/ar-mine/FIERCE。

title: From Gameplay to Policy: Towards Scalable Robot Data Collection via Gamified Robot-Free Interaction
summary: Learning generalizable robot manipulation policies requires large-scale and diverse interaction data, yet collecting real-world demonstrations remains costly and difficult to scale. Existing approaches to data collection are either dependent on specific robot hardware that limits crowdsourcing and transferability, or suffer from incomplete annotation and limited behavioral diversity. Inspired by how games sustain long-term human engagement, we explore an alternative paradigm that turns data collection into an engaging gameplay experience and transfers the resulting human manipulation experience to real robots. We present Project Kitchen, a VR-based gamified egocentric data collection platform that elicits diverse, goal-directed manipulation while remaining independent of specific robot embodiments and hardware, making it applicable to broader and potentially large-scale deployment. To bridge the game-to-real gap, we further introduce Game2Policy, which extracts embodiment-invariant affordance cues, including contact points and sub-goal states, from gameplay trajectories. An affordance model is pre-trained on game-collected data and then jointly fine-tuned with downstream policies using only a handful of real-robot demonstrations. Experiments show that Game2Policy improves average success rates by 10.0 points in simulation and 18.3 points on real robots in the few-shot setting. User studies and quantitative analyses further show that Project Kitchen promotes diverse manipulation behaviors and provides an engaging data collection experience. These results demonstrate the potential of gamified virtual environments as a scalable source of manipulation knowledge. The platform and code will be released upon acceptance.
tldr: This paper introduces Project Kitchen, a VR-based gamified platform for collecting large-scale, embodiment-invariant robot manipulation data, and Game2Policy, a method that transfers these gameplay trajectories to real robot policies via affordance modeling, significantly improving few-shot success rates.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了Project Kitchen，一个基于VR的游戏化平台，用于大规模收集与具体机器人无关的操作数据，以及Game2Policy，一种通过affordance建模将游戏轨迹迁移到真实机器人策略的方法，显著提升了少样本成功率。
summary_zh: 学习泛化的机器人操作策略需要大规模、多样化的交互数据，然而采集真实世界示教数据成本高昂且难以扩展。现有数据采集方法要么依赖特定机器人硬件，限制了众包和外推能力，要么存在标注不完整和行为多样性不足的问题。受游戏能够长期维持人类参与度的启发，我们探索了一种替代范式，将数据采集转化为引人入胜的游戏体验，并将由此获得的人类操作经验迁移至真实机器人。我们提出了 Project Kitchen——一个基于VR的 gamified 第一人称数据采集平台，能够激发多样化、目标导向的操作行为，同时不依赖于特定的机器人形态和硬件，从而适用于更广泛且可能大规模部署的场景。为弥合游戏与现实之间的差距，我们进一步提出了 Game2Policy，从游戏轨迹中提取与具身无关的可供性线索，包括接触点和子目标状态。可供性模型先在游戏采集数据上进行预训练，再仅利用少量真实机器人示教与下游策略进行联合微调。实验表明，在少样本设置下，Game2Policy 在仿真中将平均成功率提升了 10.0 个百分点，在真实机器人上提升了 18.3 个百分点。用户研究和定量分析进一步表明，Project Kitchen 促进了多样化的操作行为，并提供了富有参与感的数据采集体验。这些结果证明了 gamified 虚拟环境作为可扩展操作知识来源的潜力。平台和代码将在论文接收后发布。

title: GroundingVLN: Reasoning and Acting with Grounding for Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Although vision-language models (VLMs) possess strong visual understanding and reasoning capabilities, existing vision-and-language navigation (VLN) agents struggle to connect semantic reasoning with spatial execution. Two coupled gaps remain in this connection, as intermediate reasoning is not explicitly anchored to visual evidence and high-level decisions lack precise spatial goals to guide low-level motion. Cognitive science suggests that human navigation bridges these levels hierarchically by anchoring cognition to relevant landmarks and guiding locomotion toward spatial goals. Motivated by this principle, we propose GroundingVLN, which uses visual grounding as a shared interface between reasoning and action. GroundingVLN first reasons with grounding by anchoring task-relevant visual evidence to precise image locations throughout structured reasoning. It then acts through grounding by predicting a progress-aligned pixel goal that a geometric planner translates into primitive actions. To learn these capabilities, we construct GroundingCOTVLN-188K, a dataset of temporally aligned grounded reasoning traces, and introduce Grounded and Execution-Aware Reinforcement Learning (GEAR), which aligns grounded reasoning and spatial decisions with downstream execution. Experiments demonstrate that GroundingVLN achieves state-of-the-art performance (69.9% SR on R2R-CE and 75.1% SR on RxR-CE) with high sample efficiency, using just 0.9% as much training data as the strongest baseline. It also generalizes strongly across datasets, attaining 59.9% SR on RxR-CE when trained solely on R2R, a gain of 20.1% over the strongest baseline.
tldr: GroundingVLN grounds visual reasoning and action in vision-language navigation by using visual grounding as a shared interface, achieving state-of-the-art success rates with high sample efficiency and strong cross-dataset generalization.
tldr_zh: GroundingVLN 通过视觉定位作为推理与动作的共享接口，在视觉语言导航中实现了最先进的成功率、高样本效率和跨数据集泛化。
summary_zh: 虽然视觉语言模型（VLMs）具备强大的视觉理解与推理能力，但现有的视觉语言导航（VLN）智能体仍难以将语义推理与空间执行有效衔接。这一衔接过程中存在两个相互关联的缺口：中间推理未明确锚定于视觉证据，且高层决策缺乏精确的空间目标来引导低层运动。认知科学表明，人类导航通过将认知锚定于相关地标并将运动导向空间目标，以分层方式实现上述两个层面的桥接。受此原理启发，我们提出GroundingVLN，将视觉定位作为推理与动作之间的共享接口。GroundingVLN首先通过结构化推理全程将任务相关的视觉证据锚定至精确图像位置，实现基于定位的推理；随后通过预测与进度对齐的像素目标，由几何规划器将其转化为基本动作，实现基于定位的动作执行。为学习这些能力，我们构建了GroundingCOTVLN-188K数据集，包含时间对齐的定位推理轨迹，并引入定位感知与执行感知的强化学习（GEAR）方法，将定位推理与空间决策同下游执行过程对齐。实验表明，GroundingVLN在R2R-CE上达到69.9%的SR、在RxR-CE上达到75.1%的SR，且样本效率极高，仅需最强基线0.9%的训练数据即可达到SOTA性能。此外，该模型表现出强大的跨数据集泛化能力，仅在R2R上训练即可在RxR-CE上达到59.9%的SR，较最强基线提升20.1%。

title: ActiveScale: Scaling Active Perception for Robots across Model, Data, and Hardware
summary: Active perception is essential for robotic manipulation when fixed viewpoints leave task-relevant information occluded or unobserved. However, enabling vision-language-action (VLA) models to reason across changing viewpoints and actively acquire informative observations remains challenging. We present ActiveScale, a framework that advances active perception through coordinated model, data, and hardware designs. Our model augments a VLA with historical video observations and explicit camera-pose supervision, using per-frame pose tokens and a lightweight prediction head to associate observations across viewpoints and support a coherent understanding of the scene. To learn from the camera motion naturally present in human activity, we introduce a scalable human--robot mid-training recipe using 1000 hours of egocentric and robotic data, adapting the model to temporal inputs and pose supervision. We further introduce Active-perception Mobile-manipulation Platform (AMP), a robotic platform that supports active perception and mobile manipulation through single-operator teleoperation, enabling scalable collection of demonstrations that coordinate viewpoint changes and manipulation. Experiments demonstrate improved success rates on active-perception tasks, while ablation studies validate the contributions of camera-pose-aware modeling and egocentric mid-training. Together, these components provide an integrated foundation for studying and developing active perception in robotic manipulation.
tldr: ActiveScale presents a framework combining model, data, and hardware innovations to enable VLA models with active perception for robotic manipulation, introducing camera-pose-aware modeling, a human-robot mid-training recipe, and a new mobile manipulation platform.
tldr_zh: ActiveScale 提出了一种结合模型、数据和硬件创新的框架，使 VLA 模型具备主动感知能力，用于机器人操作，引入了相机位姿感知建模、人机中训练方案和新的移动操作平台。
summary_zh: 主动感知对于机器人操作至关重要，尤其是在固定视角导致任务相关信息被遮挡或无法观测的情况下。然而，使视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型能够在不断变化的视角中进行推理，并主动获取信息丰富的观测，仍然是一项挑战。我们提出了ActiveScale，一个通过模型、数据和硬件协同设计来推进主动感知能力的框架。我们的模型在VLA基础上增加了历史视频观测和显式相机位姿监督，利用逐帧位姿标记和轻量级预测头来关联不同视角下的观测，并支持对场景的一致性理解。为了从人类活动中自然存在的相机运动中进行学习，我们引入了一种可扩展的人-机器人中训练方案，使用1000小时的自我中心和机器人数据，使模型适应时序输入和位姿监督。我们进一步推出了主动感知移动操作平台（AMP），该机器人平台通过单操作员遥操作支持主动感知和移动操作，从而能够可扩展地收集协调视角变化与操作的演示数据。实验表明，该框架在主动感知任务上提高了成功率，而消融研究验证了相机位姿感知建模和以自我为中心的中训练所作出的贡献。这些组件共同为研究和开发机器人操作中的主动感知提供了集成基础。

title: TAO-Force: Unifying Force-Aware Perception and Fast-Slow Control for Contact-Rich Manipulation
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated strong performance across diverse robotic manipulation tasks, yet their predominantly vision-centric perception and position-controlled execution remain insufficient for contact-rich manipulation. Visual observations alone often provide limited evidence of contact onset and interaction magnitude, while position-control policies cannot respond compliantly to rapidly changing contact dynamics. To bridge both the perception and control gaps, we propose TAO-Force, a force-conditioned VLA framework that combines force-aware policy learning with contact-regulated execution. For force-aware perception, TAO-Force introduces Force-conditioned Feature-wise Linear Modulation (F-FiLM) to inject encoded force feedback into the representations of a frozen pretrained visual-language backbone while preserving its semantic priors. For responsive control, it employs a contact-gated fast-slow architecture, with a slow position-control branch tracking nominal trajectories during non-contact phases and a fast admittance-control branch regulating physical interaction during contact phases. Detailed analyses on a force-perception task and real-world evaluations across four contact-rich manipulation tasks validate the effectiveness and robustness of TAO-Force.
tldr: TAO-Force introduces a force-conditioned VLA framework for contact-rich manipulation, combining force-aware perception via FiLM injection into a frozen visual-language backbone with a contact-gated fast-slow control architecture for responsive execution.
tldr_zh: TAO-Force提出了一种力条件化的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）框架，通过将力反馈注入冻结的视觉-语言骨干网络实现力感知，并结合接触门控的快慢控制架构以应对接触丰富的操作任务。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在多种机器人操作任务中展现出了强大的性能，但其以视觉为中心的感知方式和基于位置控制的执行策略，在涉及密集接触的操作任务中仍显不足。仅凭视觉观测，往往难以提供接触起始时刻及交互力大小的充分证据，而位置控制策略也无法对快速变化的接触动力学做出顺应性响应。为同时弥补感知与控制两方面的不足，我们提出了TAO-Force，一种融合力觉条件的VLA框架，将力感知策略学习与接触调控执行相结合。在力感知方面，TAO-Force引入了基于力条件的特征级线性调制（F-FiLM），在保留冻结预训练视觉-语言骨干网络语义先验的同时，将编码后的力反馈注入其表征之中。在响应控制方面，TAO-Force采用接触门控的快慢双分支架构：慢速位置控制分支在非接触阶段跟踪标称轨迹，快速导纳控制分支则在接触阶段调节物理交互。在力感知任务上的详细分析以及四项密集接触操作任务的真实世界评估，验证了TAO-Force的有效性与鲁棒性。

title: ActionPiece: Rethinking Action Tokenization for Autoregressive Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Action tokenizers play a central role in autoregressive vision-language-action (VLA) models, determining both the targets for policy training and the executable commands recovered from predicted tokens. Their fidelity is commonly evaluated using pointwise reconstruction metrics such as mean squared error (MSE), yet small individual errors do not fully characterize how faithfully action adjustments across demonstrations are preserved. After compression, similar actions may still cluster around a representative motion, while the adjustments needed for different contexts are diminished, distorted, or even reversed. We introduce physical rank consistency (PRC) to measure how well tokenization preserves local physical distance rankings after reconstruction. Evaluating decoded actions provides a common reference across token vocabularies and decoder architectures, complementing pointwise accuracy with a measure of relational fidelity. We further present ActionPiece, which preserves physical action relationships through joint supervision of representation learning and quantization. Physical rank preservation supervises near-far ordering in encoder and quantized feature distances, while quantization regularization applies the same ordering to codeword assignment distributions. Both objectives augment reconstruction, producing discrete action tokens for standard autoregressive policy learning and execution through a frozen decoder. Under the same Qwen3-VL-4B policy training setup, ActionPiece achieves 94.8% on LIBERO and 68.8% on unseen LIBERO-Plus, with additional evaluations reaching 71.9% on SimplerEnv and 51.5% across VLA-Arena L0-L2. Component ablations show that the two objectives jointly improve PRC and policy success, demonstrating the value of physical relationship supervision for action tokenization.
tldr: This paper introduces ActionPiece, an action tokenizer for autoregressive VLA models that uses physical rank consistency (PRC) and joint supervision of representation learning and quantization to preserve local physical distance rankings among actions, improving policy success on LIBERO, SimplerEnv, and VLA-Arena benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出 ActionPiece，一种用于自回归 VLA 模型的动作分词器，通过物理秩一致性（PRC）及表示学习和量化的联合监督，保留动作间局部物理距离排序，提升了在 LIBERO、SimplerEnv 和 VLA-Arena 基准上的策略成功率。
summary_zh: 动作分词器在自回归视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中发挥着核心作用，既决定了策略训练的目标，也决定了从预测标记中恢复的可执行命令。其保真度通常使用逐点重建指标（如均方误差，MSE）进行评估，但较小的个体误差并不能充分反映跨演示中动作调整被保留的忠实程度。经过压缩后，相似动作仍可能聚集在代表性运动附近，而不同情境所需的调整则被削弱、扭曲甚至颠倒。我们引入了物理秩一致性（PRC）来衡量分词在重建后保留局部物理距离排序的能力。对解码动作进行评估为不同标记词汇表和解码器架构提供了共同参考，以关系保真度指标补充逐点精度。我们进一步提出了ActionPiece方法，通过表示学习和量化的联合监督来保留物理动作关系。物理秩保留监督编码器和量化特征距离中的远近排序，而量化正则化则将相同排序应用于码字分配分布。这两个目标函数均增强重建效果，生成离散动作标记，用于标准自回归策略学习，并通过冻结解码器执行。在相同的Qwen3-VL-4B策略训练设置下，ActionPiece在LIBERO上达到94.8%，在未见过的LIBERO-Plus上达到68.8%，在SimplerEnv上的额外评估达到71.9%，在VLA-Arena L0-L2上平均达到51.5%。组件消融实验表明，这两个目标函数共同提升了PRC和策略成功率，证明了物理关系监督对动作分词的价值。

title: ForwardDLO: Model-Based Bimanual Shape Matching of Unconstrained Deformable Linear Objects
summary: Ropes, cables, and other deformable linear objects appear in tasks from untangling to cable routing and suturing, yet controlling their shape remains a challenge in robot manipulation. We study model-based shape control in a general setting: the object lies unfixated on a support surface and two arms may grasp and move it anywhere along its length. Because each arm chooses a grasp point, direction, and magnitude, the joint action space is combinatorially large, and the dynamics model's per-prediction cost bounds how much of it a planner can search. We present ForwardDLO, a recurrent latent dynamics model for this unfixated bimanual setting that predicts per-segment displacements grounded in the observed rope state at every step. Our model reaches accuracy comparable to more expensive baselines while containing no explicit segment-to-segment operations, which makes batched evaluation of candidate actions cheap. On open-loop prediction of real rope motion it reaches the lowest error of the learned models we evaluate, 13% below the strongest baseline. Within a fixed time budget it scores 8 to 22 times more candidate actions than models of comparable accuracy while matching them in real-world shape matching; and on a simulated routing task at a 30Hz control rate, this throughput converts into 98% task success versus at most 30% for the baselines at their own budgets. We release the model, code, and a dataset of 2.42 million simulated and 14,107 real rope transitions at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ForwardDLO/
tldr: ForwardDLO presents a recurrent latent dynamics model for model-based bimanual shape matching of deformable linear objects, enabling efficient planning and high task success in real and simulated robotic manipulation.
tldr_zh: ForwardDLO提出了一种用于无固定双机械臂变形线性物体形状匹配的循环潜在动力学模型，通过高效规划实现了真实与仿真环境中的高任务成功率。
summary_zh: 绳索、电缆及其他可变形线性物体出现在从解结到线缆布线及缝合等各类任务中，然而对其形状的控制仍是机器人操作领域的一项挑战。我们研究通用设定下的基于模型形状控制：物体松散地放置在支撑表面上，两条机械臂可沿其任意长度位置进行抓取和移动。由于每条机械臂需选择抓取点、方向及力度，联合动作空间呈组合级增长，而动力学模型的单次预测成本限制了规划器在该空间内可搜索的范围。我们提出ForwardDLO，一种针对此非固定双机械臂场景的循环潜在动力学模型，该模型在每一步基于所观测的绳索状态预测每段位移。我们的模型在精度上达到与更昂贵基线相当的水平，同时避免了显式的段间操作，从而使得对候选动作的批量评估成本更低。在真实绳索运动的开环预测中，其误差在所有评估的学习模型中最低，比最强基线低13%。在固定时间预算内，它能评估的候选动作数量是精度相近模型的8至22倍，同时在真实形状匹配中达到与之相当的表现；在模拟布线任务中，以30Hz控制频率运行时，该吞吐量转化为98%的任务成功率，而基线方法在其自身预算下最多仅为30%。我们已在https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ForwardDLO/ 公开模型、代码以及包含242万条模拟和14107条真实绳索状态转移的数据集。

title: VLM-MPPI: Grounding Natural Language in Behaviorally Diverse Trajectories for Aerial Navigation
summary: We present a hierarchical UAV navigation framework that aligns natural-language intent with dynamically feasible flight behaviors in cluttered indoor environments. To bridge the gap between abstract semantics and low-level control, we employ a parallelized ensemble of six behavior-conditioned Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) planners. Crucially, by designing mode-specific guiding costs and sampling biases, we induce distinct trajectory modes that converge to unique behavioral means, yielding a compact set of intentionally diverse candidates rather than mere stochastic variations. We project these 3D candidates onto the onboard first-person-view RGB stream, turning language grounding into a visual action selection problem. A pretrained vision--language model (VLM) asynchronously selects the candidate index given the overlaid FPV image and a natural-language prompt, while MPPI replans at 20Hz and a PID-based low-level controller tracks the selected trajectory. We implement the full pipeline in NVIDIA Isaac Sim and on a real-world quadrotor platform equipped with LiDAR and RGB sensing. Experiments in both simulation and real-world flights show semantically meaningful behavior diversity, robust language alignment despite VLM latency, and safe, repeatable flight across all modes, achieving 100% task success in our evaluated scenarios.
tldr: This paper introduces a hierarchical UAV navigation framework that uses a vision-language model to select from diverse, behavior-conditioned MPPI trajectory candidates, enabling natural-language-guided flight in cluttered environments with real-robot validation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种分层无人机导航框架，利用视觉语言模型从多样化的行为条件MPPI轨迹候选中进行选择，实现在杂乱环境中的自然语言引导飞行，并在仿真和真机中验证。
summary_zh: 我们提出了一种分层无人机导航框架，该框架将自然语言意图与杂乱室内环境中的动态可行飞行行为对齐。为弥合抽象语义与底层控制之间的鸿沟，我们采用了一组由六个行为条件化的模型预测路径积分（MPPI）规划器组成的并行集成系统。关键在于，通过设计特定模式的引导代价与采样偏置，我们诱导出收敛至不同行为均值的独特轨迹模式，从而生成一组紧凑且意图多样的候选轨迹，而非仅是随机变异。我们将这些三维候选轨迹投影至机载第一人称视角（FPV）RGB图像流上，将语言接地转化为视觉动作选择问题。一个预训练的视觉-语言模型（VLM）以异步方式根据叠加了FPV图像及自然语言提示选择候选索引，同时MPPI以20Hz频率重新规划，并由基于PID的底层控制器跟踪所选轨迹。我们在NVIDIA Isaac Sim中实现了完整流程，并在配备LiDAR与RGB传感的真实四旋翼平台上进行了验证。仿真与真实飞行实验均表明，该方法具有语义上有意义的行为多样性、即使在VLM延迟下仍能保持稳健的语言对齐，并且所有模式均能实现安全、可重复的飞行，在评估场景中达到100%的任务成功率。

title: Risk-Aware World Modeling with Flow-Guided Occupancy Evolution for Selective Trajectory Planning in Automated Driving
summary: Safe motion planning in automated driving requires anticipating evolving traffic risks and deciding when to revise the current planned trajectory. We introduce RiskWorld, a risk-aware world modeling framework for shared occupancy forecasting and selective trajectory replacement. Spatial risk fields and temporal actor context are fused with visual bird's-eye-view features. Flow-guided evolution transports occupancy and scene features, while signed residuals correct occupancy after transport. One forecast is generated per planning step and reused across candidates. Each candidate is compared with a current-state persistence reference, yielding a nonnegative collision-score correction. The trajectory selected by current-world evaluation serves as the planning anchor and is replaced only when additional predicted risk triggers intervention and an alternative satisfies component-wise constraints on predicted risk and trajectory error. Candidate geometries remain unchanged. We evaluate RiskWorld for open-loop planning on nuScenes using camera features, annotation-derived current and historical actor states, and dataset-provided map context. RiskWorld achieves the lowest collision rate at a long evaluation horizon of 3 s, and the second-best average L2 error among various state-of-the-art baselines, while running at 11.5 FPS on a single NVIDIA RTX 4090 with 90.81 M parameters. Within-setting ablations show that RiskWorld achieves lower collision rates than the current-state rescoring baseline, while forecast reuse enables additional candidates to be evaluated at low marginal computational cost.
tldr: RiskWorld is a risk-aware world modeling framework for automated driving that couples occupancy forecasting with selective trajectory planning, reducing collision rates at long horizons with efficient forecast reuse.
tldr_zh: RiskWorld 是一个用于自动驾驶的风险感知世界建模框架，将占用预测与选择性轨迹规划相结合，在长时域下降低碰撞率并通过预测复用提高效率。
summary_zh: 安全运动规划在自动驾驶中需要预测不断演变的交通风险，并决定何时修订当前规划轨迹。我们提出RiskWorld，一种用于共享占用预测和选择性轨迹替换的风险感知世界建模框架。空间风险场和时间维度上的参与者上下文与视觉鸟瞰图特征相融合。流引导演化机制传输占用和场景特征，而带符号残差在传输后校正占用。每个规划步骤生成一次预测，并在多个候选轨迹间复用。每个候选轨迹与当前状态持续性参考进行比较，产生非负碰撞评分修正。由当前世界评估选出的轨迹作为规划锚点，仅在额外预测风险触发干预且替代方案满足预测风险和轨迹误差的分量约束时被替换。候选轨迹几何形状保持不变。我们在nuScenes数据集上评估了用于开环规划的RiskWorld，使用相机特征、标注推导的当前和历史参与者状态，以及数据集提供的地图上下文。RiskWorld在3秒的长评估时长下实现了最低碰撞率，并在多种最先进基线中取得第二优的平均L2误差，同时在单张NVIDIA RTX 4090上以11.5 FPS运行，参数量为90.81 M。在相同设置下的消融实验表明，RiskWorld实现了比当前状态重评分基线更低的碰撞率，而预测复用使额外候选轨迹能够以较低的边际计算成本进行评估。

title: DetAug: Obstacle-Blind Trajectory Augmentation for Zero-shot Obstacle Avoidance
summary: Policies for robotic manipulation are produced by training on large teleoperated datasets. These datasets typically consist of free-space trajectories, making them difficult to transfer to test-time environments with obstacles. Previous methods for closing this gap have largely fallen into two groups. Dataset augmentation addresses it at training time but needs obstacle geometry in advance, whereas steering an existing checkpoint at inference time avoids that requirement but is limited in flexibility. Our method draws from both areas without inheriting either drawback. DetAug applies an obstacle-blind augmentation scheme to the transit phases of a free-space dataset, leaving object interactions untouched, and records the augmentation parameters as an explicit conditioning label. At inference it samples a batch of labels and executes the trajectory with the lowest collision cost. On the SafeLIBERO benchmark DetAug achieves a collision-free success rate more than 20pp above the next best method, and selecting over the label space outperforms guidance on the same policy by 26pp. On real hardware, inference-time steering methods collapse on tasks requiring large detours, while DetAug matches or exceeds an obstacle-conditioned baseline without ever seeing obstacles in training.
tldr: DetAug proposes an obstacle-blind trajectory augmentation method for robotic manipulation that records augmentation parameters as conditioning labels and selects low-collision trajectories at inference, achieving strong zero-shot obstacle avoidance on SafeLIBERO and real hardware.
tldr_zh: DetAug 提出了一种障碍盲轨迹增强方法，通过将增强参数作为条件标签并在推理时选择低碰撞轨迹，在 SafeLIBERO 和真实硬件上实现了强大的零样本避障能力。
summary_zh: 用于机器人操控的策略通常通过对大规模遥操作数据集进行训练而生成。这些数据集通常包含自由空间中的轨迹，因此难以将其迁移至包含障碍物的测试环境中。以往用于弥合这一差距的方法大致可分为两类：数据集增强在训练阶段处理该问题，但需要事先获取障碍物的几何信息；而推理阶段对现有模型进行引导则无需这一要求，但灵活性有限。我们的方法兼取两者之长，同时避免了两者的不足。DetAug 在自由空间数据集的过渡阶段应用一种不依赖障碍物信息的增强方案，避免影响物体交互部分，并将增强参数作为显式条件标签记录下来。在推理时，它采样一组标签，并执行碰撞代价最低的轨迹。在 SafeLIBERO 基准测试中，DetAug 的无碰撞成功率达到较次优方法高出 20 个百分点以上，且在标签空间上的选择相比对同一策略进行引导的方法高出 26 个百分点。在实际硬件测试中，推理阶段的引导方法在需要大幅绕行的任务中失效，而 DetAug 在训练过程中从未见过障碍物的情况下，仍能达到甚至超过基于障碍物条件设定的基线方法的性能。

title: DistAL: Distance-based Advantage Learning for VLA Fine-Tuning
summary: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) have trans- formed the field of robotic manipulation in recent years by combining the semantic understanding of LLMs with the precise control of flow-matching policies. Advantage conditioning is a recent technique that iteratively improves VLAs by training a value function on deployment data and using this to train an advantage-conditioned policy. Previous works have only applied simple, low-information success/failure rewards, which leave the value function unable to distinguish states of differing quality beyond how far along the task they appear. Motivated by an exploration of out-of-distribution (OOD) detection methods, we introduce Distance-based Advantage Learning (DistAL), which, by using an embedding space distance as a reward, produces a more informative value function and subsequently a higher downstream task success rate. We validate our method on a series of simulation benchmarks and dexterous bi-manual manipulation tasks on real hardware.
tldr: DistAL improves VLA fine-tuning by using embedding-space distance as a reward signal for advantage conditioning, yielding more informative value functions and higher success rates on simulation and real dexterous bi-manual manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: DistAL 通过使用嵌入空间距离作为奖励信号进行优势条件化，改进了 VLA 微调，从而产生更信息丰富的价值函数，并在仿真和真实灵巧双手机器人操作任务上获得了更高的成功率。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作模型（VLAs）近年来通过将大型语言模型（LLMs）的语义理解与流匹配策略的精确控制相结合，彻底改变了机器人操作领域。优势条件化是近期兴起的一项技术，它通过在部署数据上训练价值函数，并利用该函数训练优势条件化策略，从而迭代式地改进VLA模型。以往的研究仅采用简单、信息量低的成功/失败奖励，这使得价值函数无法区分除任务进展程度之外的状态质量差异。受离分布（OOD）检测方法探索的启发，我们提出了基于距离的优势学习（DistAL），该方法通过利用嵌入空间距离作为奖励，产生更具信息量的价值函数，进而提升下游任务的成功率。我们在系列仿真基准测试以及真实硬件上的灵巧双臂操作任务中验证了该方法的有效性。

title: Decoupling Vision, Language, and Action for Efficient Multi-Task Robot Policies
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies commonly run Vision-Language Model (VLM) backbones with billions of parameters at every policy inference, which costs latency and energy.
